name: agentmemory
description: #1 Persistent memory for AI coding agents based on real-world benchmarks

capability_evidence.multi-agent-orchestration: ep / vector / agentmemory adapters score side-by-side, NDJSON output, published scorecards land in docs/benchmarks/.
capability_evidence.api-gateway: UTOCOMPRESS=true; it can make a request for each captured observation, so check your provider's current pricing before enabling it.
capability_evidence.memory-context: Persistent memory across coding sessions and agents.
capability_evidence.skills-plugins: agentmemory ships 17 skills in the Claude-Code-style /SKILL.md format: 9 invocable action skills (remember, recall, recap, handoff, forget, lesson, commit-context, commit-history, session-history) and 8 reference skills…
capability_evidence.agent-runtime: hit in default keyless mode through BM25.
capability_evidence.mcp-support: memory across coding sessions and agents.
capability_evidence.security-isolation: memoryclaudebridgesync Read MEMORY.md or create a project export, preserving existing files
capability_evidence.self-hosted: agnostics:* Run agentmemory doctor or restart with --verbose.
capability_evidence.team-collaboration: bridge* Read MEMORY.md and export project memories without replacing existing files
capability_evidence.gui-desktop: iii-engine v0.25.0 binary installed manually; download the matching archive from the iii v0.25.0 release page, verify its checksum, and place iii.exe on PATH (for example %USERPROFILE%\.local\bin\iii.exe).
capability_evidence.notifications: hook engine injects CLAUDEPLUGINROOT into hook subprocesses (per codex-rs/hooks/src/engine/discovery.rs), so the same hook scripts work across both hosts without duplication.
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Aider, Claude Code, Cline, Codex

friction.note_en: Easy. install via npx one-liner, global npm install; needs git clone (build from source), npm install/build; configure environment variables, API key configuration; no code needed
friction.note_zh: 较易上手。可通过 npx one-liner、global npm install 安装；需要 git clone (build from source)、npm install/build；需配置 environment variables、API key configuration；no code needed

analysis.summary_en: Persistent memory across coding sessions and agents.
highlights: Auth uses JWT middleware in src/middleware/auth.ts
